text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Gasp...! Could what they're talking about 
over there\npossibly be... romance 
gossip!?)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(They met in the park and started 
exchanging greetings?\nAnd hit it off over 
their shared hobby of sketching.\n...Mhm, 
I see, I see.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(So you exchanged contact info, but can't 
find the courage to send a LANE message, 
huh? Hehe, what a bittersweet dilemma...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Ghk, that was a close one! I will not 
succumb to romance gossip today. Never 
again will I expose such a lovestruck 
expression to the public—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
An invitation to an art museum?! Isn't 
that basically a date...?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah......... *cough*. T-Today is another 
peaceful day at the academy, which is 
wonderful.
